meta.title: Leonida Platinum Guide — GTA VI trophies (PS5)
meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades verified against the live PlayStation trophy list as mirrored by Exophase and cross-checked against five independent full lists (18 Nov 2026). Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft have not published a list on their own channels. Guide text is written in our own words. Five hidden trophies have no confirmed unlock method yet at launch and say so. No Gamerscore values are shown: published Xbox values conflict between sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. There is no shortcut: the long pole is A Long Road, the 100% completion Gold. Work the roadmap in order — story first, side stories second, free-roam grinds last — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the 100% checklist (reported as 35 tasks), found after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Work done before the credits still counts. The checklist is mostly other trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 Illegal Operations. Do it last, after the credits, when everything is open.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land stunt jumps, fly under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — anything the game counts as a stunt. The counter runs all game, so keep an eye on Progress. You need 250 for the trophy and 300 for 100%, so do not stop at 250.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across the two ranges, as reported. Treat it as a skill check, not a grind: learn each range's pattern, then run them back to back once your aim is warm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; every vault immediately gives you a 4-star Wanted Level, so escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon): do it the moment it appears, and save first.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; grab them as you explore rather than hunting them all at the end. Track sets in your collection screen so you know which set still needs cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan (WAiNK It) 100 locations. Scan everything you pass — landmarks, shops, signs — and the total climbs on its own. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once, as reported. The activities list is in your Progress menu — work through it early so you know what exists, then the trophy pops as soon as the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix street races, drone races and any other race type; your wins are tracked per event.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat. The easiest setup is a bank vault job (Maximum Withdrawal): it hands you 4 stars at once. Break line of sight, leave the red heat zone, and wait for the stars to clear — the trophy pops once you are fully clear, not while you are still hiding.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row without letting your Wanted Level drop. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — keep the heat on between shops and move fast. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. You need 200 of the 277 base models for 100%, as reported, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region on the map. Drive the roads, visit each area, and watch the map fill in. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery grinds.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs, as reported. Operations are marked on the map once you find them; the 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way. Bring heavy weapons — operations are guarded.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative across the whole game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, as reported. Win at least one race at each; learn each course's turns before chasing the win.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every kind of shop — weapons, clothes, food, anything. It fills up naturally if you buy gear as you go; check your spending in Stats if you are close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, as reported. Garages the story gives you do not count — only bought ones.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as you play the fishing activity; win the head-to-head against Cal and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any arcade machine, any game, one full playthrough. Arcades are in Vice City; sit down, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this and disappears after that chapter. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, as reported. Spots show as purple icons when you are close. Reported: each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. CAN MISS: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this and disappears after Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies — the guards at an Illegal Operation work well — and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so build it up first.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies. Use the Snap Gun on the store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — ambush one, grab the cash, and lose the heat. It pairs with the bank-vault jobs in Chapter 4, so try it while you are already geared for robberies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges — 80 in total, as reported. Many complete on their own while you play; the 100% checklist asks for 70, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Unmissable. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, as reported, so do not worry if it is a few minutes late.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable — it pops as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. Note: PlayStation publishes this name in the censored form shown here; Press-Start prints it uncensored, and the uncensored form matches the Chapter 3 title reported by GameSpot and others. Re-verified at build time (19 Nov 2026): the live Exophase list shows the description only, so the censored PSN form is used, as the competition's official list requires.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Unmissable — but keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and you will want that save for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run (Chapter 2). Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3, its final mission). Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so there is no rush — finish Kenton's strand when you are ready.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finale; stays available after the credits. Note: Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finale; stays available after the credits. Reported: Andy's questline is Lucia-only. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finale; stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finale; stays available after the credits. Reported: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only. Note: Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, as reported, and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The finale stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work, as reported; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos'. Tanks are reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an Illegal Operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reported: it pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner — your partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Reported: it counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. The most likely reading is a specific bar or viewpoint on Ocean Beach; try the beachfront bars and viewpoints. This guide will update the method once it is confirmed — do not trust any method that is not confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. It most likely involves driving a car through a showroom's glass front; the exact showroom is not confirmed. Do not trust unconfirmed methods.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. The phrasing suggests retrying something that failed once; what exactly is not confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. It most likely marks a strange or paranormal event somewhere in Leonida; the trigger is not confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. The likely reading is a melee drive-by at a bowling alley (Kingpin Bowling), but that is a deduction from the description, not a confirmed method.
